text:
alex: opened PR #8477 — migration guide for Private + SDK examples. contains an example `redwood_config` with a mock-looking KMS arn and a demo api key. tagging legal + security for quick scrub before main.
mira: can you paste the snippet here so we can scrub fast?
alex: snippet: ```yaml
redwood:
  api_key: sk-live-12345
  kms: arn:aws:kms:eu-west-1:222233334444:key/aaaBBBccc
```
devexp: heads-up — our docs lint will fail on live-looking keys and ARNs. Please replace with `<API_KEY>` and `<KMS_KEY_ARN>` and mark the block non-executable (```text) if it's illustrative.
sec-bot: auto-detected sensitive pattern: arn:aws:kms in branch. recommend: (1) placeholders, (2) change fence to ```text, (3) add ops note to use KMS aliases/env vars in Private. run `tools/sensitive-check` locally.
legal: policy: no account identifiers or real ARNs in docs. If the sample shows key usage, use synthetic placeholders and add the mandatory sentence: "This document uses placeholders for keys and other sensitive identifiers. Do not paste production secrets into docs."
alex: will push a scrub commit and add the sentence + small redaction checklist in the PR body.
docs-ci: preview failed for PR #8477 — sensitive-checker flagged 2 matches (api key pattern, ARN) in migration-guide.md: line 33. logs: https://ci.internal/job/8477/console
mira: thanks — alex, after your scrub, update the PR description with the commit hash so legal can track the redaction. Also update any anchors; older SDK anchors sometimes cause linkcheck to fail and block canary.
alex: pushed commit 9f1a2b: replaced strings with `<API_KEY>` and `<KMS_KEY_ARN>`, changed code fence to ```text, added required top-line sentence, included checklist with commit link.
docs-ci: re-run triggered by 9f1a2b. preview passed for PR #8477 — no sensitive matches, linkcheck OK, exec-check OK. artifacts: https://ci.internal/job/8477/preview.zip
ops: timeline question — can we merge to docs-staging for a canary while legal does final review? we want to run the canary at 02:00 UTC.
legal: ok to merge to staging if: (a) placeholders in place, (b) docs-ci green, (c) PR description lists the redaction commit(s) and checklist. final legal approval required before main.
mira: i'll handle the merge to docs-staging at 01:45 UTC and add a release note: "Canary: migration guide (PR #8477) — redaction applied; legal pending final sign-off."
sec-bot: add follow-up ticket to add pre-commit sensitive checks for docs authors (not blocking).
alex: merging to docs-staging now and pinging @legal for staging review. thanks all. :thumbsup:
docs-ci: merged PR #8477 to docs-staging by mira. Release note published.
legal: we'll review the staging preview and provide final sign-off or request additional redaction before main.
ops: will schedule the canary deploy and monitor traffic for any telemetry spikes. revert plan in place.
alex: filing a small internal doc (DOCS-2201) with the redaction checklist so authors follow this flow next time. closing thread for now — ping if legal asks for changes.
